body:
Added /portal/login to the OKEMILY footer (alongside the existing /admin/login link). Added a matching /portal same-origin nginx proxy block (both server stanzas) so it resolves on okemily.com, mirroring /admin/'s existing reasoning -- not yet applied live, queued as sudo-queue/27-okemily-portal-nginx-proxy.sh. Deployed content via okemily-deploy.sh. Commit 557e70d.

⚓ ☃
title: Footer: linked notebook portal login + queued its nginx proxy
